text.text: Sublimation grants abilities derived from the tool's own definition. Each level costs 1 Elevation, each path has 5 levels, and only one path may be chosen in a group. Sword, scythe, axe, and hammer groups replace Melee; Bow replaces Ranged. Harvest is never replaced.
The Sublimation page lists only paths available to the current tool. Hover either adjustment button to see the exact effect, current level, level cap, and cost per level.
